sys_remote_update_set.description:
Loan Desk - equipment loan desk for internal IT (custom Global application on table u_loan_request).
STORIES Story 1 - LOAN DESK SCHEMA: Loan Request table u_loan_request (extends task) with fields, labels, choices, LN numbering, Loan Desk menu and Loan Requests module. Story 2 - SERVER GOVERNANCE: Business rule "Loan Request approval gatekeeper" aborts illegal status transitions on every entry point. Story 3 - FORM USABILITY: UI policy hides Notes until a Requester is chosen; onChange client scripts warn when status becomes Returned without a Due date. Story 4 - NIGHTLY AUTOMATION: Scheduled script execution "Loan Desk - Overdue loan sweep" (daily 02:00) flags overdue approved loans and fires event u_loan_request.overdue, which sends the "Loan Overdue Alert" email. Story 5 - SECURITY MODEL: Roles lab_borrower and lab_supervisor with record and field ACLs on u_loan_request. Story 6 - PRESENTATION LAYER: Form with sections Identification, Scheduling, Remarks (Overdue read-only) and list layout with overdue tracking.
MANUAL TEST PLAN Story 1: Open Loan Desk, then Loan Requests, click New. Expect number LN0001001, Loan status defaulting to Requested, Requester and Asset tag mandatory. Check System Definition, Tables for u_loan_request extending Task in Global scope. Story 2: As admin create a loan (status Requested). Set Loan status to Returned and save: expect an error message and no change. Set Loan status to Approved without a Due date and save: expect an error message. Set a Due date, save, set Approved, save, set Returned, save: all succeed. Repeat the illegal update through the REST Table API (PATCH u_loan_status=returned on a requested loan): expect the request to be rejected with the same message. Story 3: Click New: Notes is hidden. Pick a Requester: Notes appears. Clear the Requester: Notes hides again. On a record with empty Due date change Loan status to Returned: a warning appears under Due date. Fill in the Due date or choose another status: the warning disappears. Editing other fields shows no warning. Story 4: Create an approved loan with a Due date in the past, one approved loan with a Due date in the future and one returned loan with a past Due date. Open System Definition, Scheduled Jobs, "Loan Desk - Overdue loan sweep" and click Execute Now. Expect Overdue = true only on the first loan and a "Loan Overdue Alert" email to the requester in System Logs, Emails naming asset tag and due date. Click Execute Now again: no record is updated and no further email is generated. Story 5: Impersonate a user with only lab_borrower: the list is readable, New works, Loan status is read-only, existing records cannot be edited or deleted. Impersonate a user with lab_supervisor: read, create, edit, approve, reject and delete all work. Impersonate a user with neither role: the Loan Desk menu is not visible and u_loan_request_list.do shows no rows (security constraints). Story 6: Open any Loan Request: the form shows sections Identification (Number, Requester, Asset tag), Scheduling (Loan status, Due date, Overdue with Overdue read-only) and Remarks (Notes). The list shows Number, Requester, Asset tag, Loan status, Due date, Overdue.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>u_loan_request</collection><condition/><description>Server-side gatekeeper for the Loan Request lifecycle. Runs before insert and update on every entry point (UI, REST, import sets, scripts). Aborts: a move to Returned from anything but Approved, a loan that is Approved without a due date, and approval or rejection by a user without the lab_supervisor role.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Loan Request approval gatekeeper</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method display_value=""/><rest_method_text/><rest_service display_value=""/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script>(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    var isInsert = current.operation() == 'insert';
    var newStatus = current.getValue('u_loan_status');
    var oldStatus = '';
    if (!isInsert) {
        if (previous) {
            oldStatus = previous.getValue('u_loan_status');
        }
    }
    var statusChanged = isInsert || newStatus != oldStatus;

    if (statusChanged) {
        // A loan can only be returned after it has been approved
        // (blocks requested to returned, rejected to returned and inserting as returned).
        if (newStatus == 'returned') {
            if (oldStatus != 'approved') {
                gs.addErrorMessage('Loan Request ' + current.getValue('number') + ' cannot be set to Returned: only an Approved loan can be returned.');
                current.setAbortAction(true);
                return;
            }
        }

        // Only loan desk supervisors (and admins) may approve or reject.
        if (newStatus == 'approved' || newStatus == 'rejected') {
            if (!gs.hasRole('lab_supervisor')) {
                gs.addErrorMessage('Loan Request ' + current.getValue('number') + ' cannot be approved or rejected: the lab_supervisor role is required.');
                current.setAbortAction(true);
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    // An approved loan must always carry a due date
    // (blocks approving without a due date and clearing the due date of an approved loan).
    if (newStatus == 'approved') {
        if (current.u_due_date.nil()) {
            gs.addErrorMessage('Loan Request ' + current.getValue('number') + ' cannot be Approved without a Due date. Set the Due date first.');
            current.setAbortAction(true);
            return;
        }
    }

})(current, previous);</script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-16 09:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>5f3a9c2e7b1d4e80a6c4d2f000060001</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Loan Request approval gatekeeper</sys_name><sys_overrides display_value=""/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_5f3a9c2e7b1d4e80a6c4d2f000060001</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-16 09:00:00</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sysauto_script"><sysauto_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><business_calendar display_value=""/><condition/><conditional>false</conditional><entered_time>1970-01-01 00:00:00</entered_time><max_drift/><name>Loan Desk - Overdue loan sweep</name><offset/><offset_type>0</offset_type><run_as display_value=""/><run_as_tz/><run_dayofmonth>1</run_dayofmonth><run_dayofweek>1</run_dayofweek><run_period/><run_start>2026-11-16 02:00:00</run_start><run_time>1970-01-01 02:00:00</run_time><run_type>daily</run_type><script>(function sweepOverdueLoans() {

    var EVENT_NAME = 'u_loan_request.overdue';

    // Today's date in the instance time zone, internal format yyyy-MM-dd.
    var today = new GlideDateTime().getLocalDate().getValue();
    var flagged = 0;

    // Only approved loans that are past their due date and not flagged yet.
    // Returned, rejected, requested, not-yet-due and already-flagged loans never match,
    // which makes every re-run idempotent (no second update, no second email).
    var loan = new GlideRecord('u_loan_request');
    loan.addQuery('u_loan_status', 'approved');
    loan.addNotNullQuery('u_due_date');
    loan.addQuery('u_due_date', '<', today);
    loan.addQuery('u_overdue', '!=', true);
    loan.query();

    while (loan.next()) {
        loan.setValue('u_overdue', true);
        if (loan.update()) {
            flagged++;
            // parm1 = requester (recipient), parm2 = asset tag
            gs.eventQueue(EVENT_NAME, loan, loan.getValue('u_requester'), loan.getValue('u_asset_tag'));
        } else {
            gs.warn('Loan Desk overdue sweep: could not flag ' + loan.getValue('number') + ' as overdue.');
        }
    }

    gs.info('Loan Desk overdue sweep: ' + flagged + ' loan(s) newly flagged as overdue (reference date ' + today + ').');

})();</script><sys_class_name>sysauto_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-16 09:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>5f3a9c2e7b1d4e80a6c4d2f000080001</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Loan Desk - Overdue loan sweep</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sysauto_script_5f3a9c2e7b1d4e80a6c4d2f000080001</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-16 09:00:00</sys_updated_on><time_zone/><upgrade_safe>false</upgrade_safe></sysauto_script></record_update>
